title: Look into it, before buying
text: Look into it, before buying. Mine slides on counter top. Theres no temperature control to turn down or up. Its very small. 4 hamburgers just fit. Not real happy with it.

product_metadata.title: George Foreman GR340FB 4-Serving Classic Plate Electric Indoor Grill and Panini Press, Black
features: Classic Plate Grill - This is the original George Foreman Grill. The durable grill plates give you lean, mean grilling power for all your favorite foods
Advanced George Tough Coating - We made the George Tough coating even strong. It’s 3x more durable**, easy to clean, and removes the need for butter and oil
Fat-Removing Slope - It’s the sure sign of a George Foreman Grill. The sloped grilling surface helps remove up to 42% of fat* from meats for lean, tasty meals
Drip Tray - The dishwasher-safe drip tray collects excess fat and grease so you don’t have to. How nice is that
description: It's the kitchen appliance that made year-round grilling possible. The George Foreman 4-serving Classic Plate Grill and Panini Press delivers fast grilling and delicious results for steak, burgers, chicken, veggies, and more. The patented sloped surface helps remove fat during cooking, and the advanced George tough nonstick coating wipes clean after every use. This compact grill is perfect for small families, and its dual contact heating speeds up grilling to get food on the table in record time. What will you make on your George Foreman grill?
